premise: A buzzy fly pesters the meadow — it tickles Deer's ears and lands on Snail's eye stalk — until Frog sits so still it comes close… SNAP.
inspiration: The patient hunter of the fables (Aesop's heron who waits by the water), turned into a gentle comedy of stillness where the flapping and stamping fail and sitting still wins.

en-US.title: Frog and the Buzzy Fly
en-US.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.6 20s} [softly] It was a warm, lazy afternoon in the meadow. {deer:enter} Deer was standing in the grass, {deer:live graze} nibbling his lunch. Then… {sfx:fly} bzzzz. A buzzy fly! It buzzed round Deer's ears. {deer:face surprised} {deer:live ear-flick} Flick, flick. "Shoo!" So it zoomed over to {snail:enter} Snail and landed right on his eye stalk. {snail:face surprised} "Tickly!" {snail:live hide hold} In he went, into his shell. Bzzzz. Back it came to Deer. {deer:live stamp} Deer stamped. {deer:face sad} [sighs] Nothing worked. The fly just buzzed and buzzed. {frog:enter} {frog:go to pond} Frog was sitting by the pond. {frog:face happy} "Leave it to me," she said. And she sat still. {frog:live catch-fly hold} Very, very still. [whispers] The fly buzzed closer… and closer… {deer:face surprised} Deer held his breath. [pause] {frog:live catch-fly resume} {sfx:snap} SNAP! Gulp. The meadow went quiet. {snail:live hide resume} Snail peeked out. "Where did the fly go?" {frog:pulse} [mischievously] "What fly?" said Frog, with a great big grin. {all:face happy} {all:wobble} [laughs] And the whole meadow laughed.

es-ES.title: Rana y la mosca zumbona
es-ES.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.6 20s} [softly] Era una tarde tranquila y calentita en el prado. {deer:enter} Ciervo estaba en la hierba, {deer:live graze} mordisqueando su comida. Y entonces… {sfx:fly} bzzzz. ¡Una mosca zumbona! Se puso a dar vueltas alrededor de sus orejas. {deer:face surprised} {deer:live ear-flick} Flic, flic. —¡Fuera, mosca! Así que la mosca se fue volando hasta {snail:enter} Caracol y se le posó en un cuernito. {snail:face surprised} —¡Ay, cosquillas! {snail:live hide hold} Y Caracol se metió en su concha. Bzzzz. Y vuelta a las orejas de Ciervo. {deer:live stamp} Ciervo dio un pisotón. {deer:face sad} [sighs] No había manera. La mosca zumbaba y zumbaba. {frog:enter} {frog:go to pond} Rana estaba sentada junto a la charca. {frog:face happy} —Dejádmela a mí —dijo. Y se quedó quieta. {frog:live catch-fly hold} Muy, muy quieta. [whispers] La mosca se acercó… y se acercó… {deer:face surprised} Ciervo contuvo el aliento. [pause] {frog:live catch-fly resume} {sfx:snap} ¡ZAS! Glup. El prado se quedó en silencio. {snail:live hide resume} Caracol asomó la cabeza. —¿Y la mosca? {frog:pulse} [mischievously] —¿Qué mosca? —dijo Rana, con una sonrisa de oreja a oreja. {all:face happy} {all:wobble} [laughs] Y todo el prado se echó a reír.

ja-JP.title: カエルさんと ぶんぶんバエ
ja-JP.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.6 20s}[softly]ぽかぽか、のんびりした、はらっぱのごご。{deer:enter}子ジカが、くさのなかで{deer:live graze}おひるごはんをもぐもぐ。すると…{sfx:fly}ぶーん。ハエです！子ジカの耳のまわりを、ぶんぶん。{deer:face surprised}{deer:live ear-flick}ぴくっ、ぴくっ。「あっちいって！」 ハエは{snail:enter}カタツムリくんのところへとんでいって、つのの先に、ぴたっ。{snail:face surprised}「くすぐったい！」 {snail:live hide hold}すぽっと、からのなかへ。ぶーん。また子ジカのところへ。{deer:live stamp}子ジカは、どん！と足ぶみ。{deer:face sad}[sighs]なにをしても、だめ。ハエは、ぶんぶん、ぶんぶん。{frog:enter}{frog:go to pond}カエルさんは、池のそばにすわっていました。{frog:face happy}「まかせて。」 そして、じっと。{frog:live catch-fly hold}じーっと、じーっと。[whispers]ハエが、ちかづいて…ちかづいて…{deer:face surprised}子ジカは、いきをとめました。[pause]{frog:live catch-fly resume}{sfx:snap}ぱくっ！ごっくん。はらっぱが、しーん。{snail:live hide resume}カタツムリくんが、のぞきました。「ハエは、どこ？」 {frog:pulse}[mischievously]「ハエって、なんのこと？」 とカエルさんは、にんまり。{all:face happy}{all:wobble}[laughs]はらっぱじゅう、大わらい。

de-DE.title: Der Frosch und die Brummfliege
de-DE.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.6 20s} [softly] Es war ein warmer, gemütlicher Nachmittag auf der Wiese. {deer:enter} Das Reh stand im Gras und {deer:live graze} knabberte sein Mittagessen. Da… {sfx:fly} bsss. Eine Brummfliege! Sie brummte dem Reh um die Ohren. {deer:face surprised} {deer:live ear-flick} Zuck, zuck. „Husch!“ Da sauste sie hinüber zur {snail:enter} Schnecke und landete genau auf ihrem Fühler. {snail:face surprised} „Das kitzelt!“ {snail:live hide hold} Schwupp, war sie im Haus. Bsss. Schon war die Fliege wieder beim Reh. {deer:live stamp} Das Reh stampfte. {deer:face sad} [sighs] Nichts half. Die Fliege brummte und brummte. {frog:enter} {frog:go to pond} Der Frosch saß am Teich. {frog:face happy} „Überlasst das mir“, sagte er. Und er saß ganz still. {frog:live catch-fly hold} Ganz, ganz still. [whispers] Die Fliege brummte näher… und näher… {deer:face surprised} Das Reh hielt den Atem an. [pause] {frog:live catch-fly resume} {sfx:snap} SCHNAPP! Schluck. Auf der Wiese wurde es still. {snail:live hide resume} Die Schnecke lugte heraus. „Wo ist denn die Fliege hin?“ {frog:pulse} [mischievously] „Welche Fliege?“, sagte der Frosch und grinste über das ganze Gesicht. {all:face happy} {all:wobble} [laughs] Und die ganze Wiese lachte.

fr-FR.title: Grenouille et la mouche
fr-FR.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.6 20s} [softly] C’était un après-midi chaud et tranquille dans le pré. {deer:enter} Faon, dans l’herbe, {deer:live graze} broutait son déjeuner. Et puis… {sfx:fly} bzzzz. Une mouche qui bourdonne ! Elle tournait autour des oreilles de Faon. {deer:face surprised} {deer:live ear-flick} Flic, flac. « Ouste ! » Alors elle a filé jusqu’à {snail:enter} Escargot et s’est posée pile sur sa corne. {snail:face surprised} « Ça chatouille ! » {snail:live hide hold} Et hop, il est rentré dans sa coquille. Bzzzz. La revoilà chez Faon. {deer:live stamp} Faon a tapé du sabot. {deer:face sad} [sighs] Rien à faire. La mouche bourdonnait, bourdonnait. {frog:enter} {frog:go to pond} Grenouille était assise au bord de la mare. {frog:face happy} « Laisse-moi faire », a-t-elle dit. Et elle est restée immobile. {frog:live catch-fly hold} Très, très immobile. [whispers] La mouche s’approchait… s’approchait… {deer:face surprised} Faon retenait son souffle. [pause] {frog:live catch-fly resume} {sfx:snap} CLAC ! Gloup. Le pré est devenu tout silencieux. {snail:live hide resume} Escargot a ressorti ses cornes. « Où est passée la mouche ? » {frog:pulse} [mischievously] « Quelle mouche ? » a dit Grenouille, avec un sourire jusqu’aux oreilles. {all:face happy} {all:wobble} [laughs] Et tout le pré a éclaté de rire.

it-IT.title: Rana e la mosca ronzina
it-IT.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.6 20s} [softly] Era un pomeriggio caldo e pigro, nel prato. {deer:enter} Cerbiatto se ne stava nell'erba, {deer:live graze} a brucare il suo pranzo. Poi… {sfx:fly} bzzzz. Una mosca ronzina! Gli ronzava intorno alle orecchie. {deer:face surprised} {deer:live ear-flick} Flic, flic. «Sciò!» Così la mosca è volata via fino a {snail:enter} Chiocciola, e si è posata proprio sulla punta di un cornino. {snail:face surprised} «Che solletico!» {snail:live hide hold} E Chiocciola è sparita nel guscio. Bzzzz. La mosca è tornata da Cerbiatto. {deer:live stamp} Cerbiatto ha battuto lo zoccolo. {deer:face sad} [sighs] Niente da fare. La mosca ronzava e ronzava. {frog:enter} {frog:go to pond} Rana era seduta vicino allo stagno. {frog:face happy} «Ci penso io», ha detto. E se n'è stata ferma. {frog:live catch-fly hold} Ferma, ferma, immobile. [whispers] La mosca si è avvicinata… sempre di più… {deer:face surprised} Cerbiatto tratteneva il fiato. [pause] {frog:live catch-fly resume} {sfx:snap} ZAC! Gnam. Nel prato è tornato il silenzio. {snail:live hide resume} Chiocciola ha fatto capolino. «Dov'è finita la mosca?» {frog:pulse} [mischievously] «Quale mosca?» ha detto Rana, con un sorrisone grande grande. {all:face happy} {all:wobble} [laughs] E tutto il prato è scoppiato a ridere.

zh-TW.title: 青蛙和嗡嗡蒼蠅
zh-TW.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.6 20s}[softly]這是草地上一個暖洋洋、懶洋洋的下午。{deer:enter}小鹿站在草叢裡，{deer:live graze}慢慢吃著午餐。突然……{sfx:fly}嗡——嗡——一隻吵吵的蒼蠅！牠繞著小鹿的耳朵飛呀飛。{deer:face surprised}{deer:live ear-flick}甩、甩。「走開！」 蒼蠅就咻地飛到{snail:enter}蝸牛那裡，剛好停在牠長著眼睛的觸角上。{snail:face surprised}「好癢！」 {snail:live hide hold}蝸牛趕快縮進殼裡。嗡——嗡——蒼蠅又飛回小鹿身邊。{deer:live stamp}小鹿跺跺腳。{deer:face sad}[sighs]怎麼趕都趕不走。蒼蠅一直嗡嗡嗡，嗡嗡嗡。{frog:enter}{frog:go to pond}青蛙正坐在池塘邊。{frog:face happy}「交給我吧。」 牠說。然後，牠一動也不動。{frog:live catch-fly hold}非常、非常安靜。[whispers]蒼蠅愈飛愈近……愈飛愈近……{deer:face surprised}小鹿屏住呼吸。[pause]{frog:live catch-fly resume}{sfx:snap}啪！咕嚕。草地一下子安靜了。{snail:live hide resume}蝸牛探出頭來。「蒼蠅跑到哪裡去了？」 {frog:pulse}[mischievously]「什麼蒼蠅？」 青蛙咧開大嘴，笑嘻嘻地說。{all:face happy}{all:wobble}[laughs]整片草地都哈哈大笑。

zh-HK.title: 青蛙同嗡嗡烏蠅
zh-HK.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.6 20s}[softly]這是一個暖洋洋、懶洋洋的下午。{deer:enter}小鹿站在草地上，{deer:live graze}慢慢地吃着午餐。忽然……{sfx:fly}嗡——嗡——一隻嗡嗡叫的蒼蠅！牠繞着小鹿的耳朵飛來飛去。{deer:face surprised}{deer:live ear-flick}耳朵撥、撥。「走開啦！」 蒼蠅就嗖一聲飛到{snail:enter}蝸牛那邊，剛好停在牠的眼睛觸角上。{snail:face surprised}「好痕呀！」 {snail:live hide hold}蝸牛連忙縮進殼裏。嗡——嗡——蒼蠅又飛回小鹿身邊。{deer:live stamp}小鹿跺跺腳。{deer:face sad}[sighs]怎樣趕也趕不走。蒼蠅一直嗡嗡嗡，嗡嗡嗡。{frog:enter}{frog:go to pond}青蛙正坐在池塘邊。{frog:face happy}「睇我嘅。」 牠說。然後，牠坐着一動也不動。{frog:live catch-fly hold}靜靜地，靜靜地。[whispers]蒼蠅愈飛愈近……愈飛愈近……{deer:face surprised}小鹿屏住了呼吸。[pause]{frog:live catch-fly resume}{sfx:snap}啪！咕嘟。草地一下子靜了下來。{snail:live hide resume}蝸牛探出頭來。「隻烏蠅去咗邊呀？」 {frog:pulse}[mischievously]「乜嘢烏蠅呀？」 青蛙咧開大嘴，笑瞇瞇地說。{all:face happy}{all:wobble}[laughs]整片草地都哈哈大笑起來。

fly.prompt: a small housefly buzzing in loops close by, realistic
